title: Make delegation result delivery consistent across whole-orchestrator Stop and restart
outcome: Decide whether whole-orchestrator Stop should pause or dispatch delegation results retained by an otherwise unpaused idle child, then make the live and restored paths follow the same policy.
acceptance: A retained delegation result on an unpaused child follows the chosen whole-orchestrator Stop policy both before and after restart.
A behavior test exercises an initially unpaused child on live Stop and restored Stop.
